data.description:
## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md:5` describes the `code-quality` prompt as:

> Reviews a code change (commits/diff) for correctness, bugs, edge cases, clarity, and
> maintainability. **The default reviewer for the code-review operation.**

That final sentence is inaccurate, and is mirrored into the generated catalog at
`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json:6` because the index is derived from prompt front-matter.

Verified on `origin/main` at `5f618b3ccff`:

- The code-review gate is `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml`. Its Pass-1a step,
  commented "the base reviewer (ALWAYS runs)" at `:68`, names `prompt: code-review-base` at
  `:71`. The string `code-quality` does not appear anywhere in that file.
- `code-quality` has `applies_to: []` in the index, and `select_reviewers`
  (`src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:607`) is purely `applies_to`-driven, so it is never
  returned by rule-based selection either.
- The only remaining references to `code-quality` as a prompt id are
  `src/rebar/_cli/_workflow_commands.py:59` (a scaffold template emitted by the workflow
  scaffolder), `src/rebar/llm/workflow/examples/review_skeleton.yaml:29` (a documentation
  example), `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-quality.eval.yaml` (its own eval spec), and
  `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/llm_eval.py:26` (an `--help` example). None is the
  code-review operation.

The inaccuracy predates epic `87d8-8bb6-5226-4a5b`: `git log -S "The default reviewer for the
code-review operation" -- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md` returns exactly one commit,
`8bc485c84c2` (story afe6, the unified prompt model migration). The code-review gate already
used a dedicated base reviewer at that point, so the sentence was wrong when introduced.

Epic 87d8 made it additionally misleading by removing the `default` front-matter key and the
"default reviewer set" concept entirely (`docs/release-notes.md:85-108`), so a reader now
encounters the phrase "the default reviewer" describing a mechanism that no longer exists.
That epic's residue in `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md` is tracked separately on
`ethologic-antisolar-queenbee`; this ticket is the independent pre-existing defect.

## Change

1. Replace the final sentence of the `description` front-matter value in
   `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md:5` with one that states what the prompt is
   actually for, without claiming a role it does not hold and without using the retired
   "default reviewer" phrasing. The preceding sentence ("Reviews a code change (commits/diff)
   for correctness, bugs, edge cases, clarity, and maintainability.") is accurate and stays.
2. Run `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index` and commit the regenerated
   `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json`, whose `code-quality.description` mirrors the
   front-matter. A CI drift gate diffs this file, so leaving it stale fails the build.

## Testing

Documentation/front-matter only — no code path changes, so the existing suite is the oracle.
The index-drift gate is the direct assertion that step 2 was not skipped. The substring
targeted below was counted on the tree first and returns 1 in each of the two files, so the
"is absent afterwards" criteria cannot pass vacuously.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1** `[ "$(grep -cF 'The default reviewer for the code-review operation' src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md)" -eq 0 ]`
      exits 0. Counted 1 before the edit.
- [ ] **AC2** `[ "$(grep -cF 'The default reviewer for the code-review operation' src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json)" -eq 0 ]`
      exits 0. Counted 1 before the edit.
- [ ] **AC3** `[ "$(grep -cF 'Reviews a code change (commits/diff) for correctness, bugs, edge cases, clarity, and maintainability.' src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md)" -eq 1 ]`
      exits 0, confirming the accurate first sentence survived.
- [ ] **AC4** `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index && git diff --exit-code src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json`
      reports no drift, proving the committed index matches the edited front-matter.
- [ ] **AC5** `python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json')); assert set(d) - {'_generated_by'} == {'code-quality','completion-verifier','security','spec-alignment','tests'}"`
      exits 0, confirming no catalog entry was added or dropped.
- [ ] **AC6** `pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py tests/unit/test_prompt_front_matter.py -q`
      exits 0.
- [ ] **AC7** `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` lists exactly two paths,
      `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md` and `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json`.
- [ ] **AC8** `make verify` exits 0.

## Out of scope — checked, not merely unexamined

- **`docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md:42` and `:201`**, which document the removed `default`
  front-matter key and its one-default invariant. That is epic 87d8's residue and is tracked
  on `ethologic-antisolar-queenbee`; the two tickets share no file.
- **Changing which reviewer the code-review gate runs.** `code-review-base` is correct; this
  ticket corrects the prose that misdescribes it, not the behavior.
- **The other four `code-quality` references** (`_workflow_commands.py:59`,
  `review_skeleton.yaml:29`, `eval_specs/code-quality.eval.yaml`, `llm_eval.py:26`). All are
  scaffold templates, examples, or the prompt's own eval spec, and all remain correct.
- **`code-quality`'s empty `applies_to`.** Whether this prompt should be glob-selectable is a
  behavior question, not a documentation defect.
data.title: code-quality prompt description claims a code-review role it does not hold
